evidence.section: Splunk has removed support for versions 1.0 and 1.1 of TLS
evidence.statement: The versioned 10.6 upgrade notice removes TLS 1.0/1.1 support. The versioned communications guide still provides the earlier temporary setting. Preserve the conflict and validate TLS 1.2 or 1.3 on the affected links.
